name: Sound Lab
description: A tour of the audio core: one-shots, buses and their effects, snapshots, ducking and a moving spatial source. Click the game view, then press 1-6 to try each feature. The other keys run the audio listening pass's tests (see the Listening bench node). Press E for the events page: footsteps by surface, an engine blended by RPM with a key-off tail, and music that gets more intense. Press M for the music page: a switch between explore, combat and calm with a cut, three crossfade curves and a bridge, stingers, a loop with a tail, and a playlist. Press R for the rhythm page: tap SPACE to a click track to calibrate the output (the offset is stored per device), then a tap game judged against the music. Press - (minus) for the mixer page: a voice that ducks the music and the ambience by its level, an SFX burst that ducks the music, a tour script that cycles them, and a loudness reference with meters and targets. Press S for the spatial page: walk a corridor of reverb zones past walls, a door you open with F, an ambisonic ambience and a Doppler flyover (V). The music and rhythm pages also have on-screen buttons and take a press on the view as a tap, so a phone can run them.
